findings.title: Decoupling cap moderately far from U1
findings.description: Nearest decoupling cap to U1 (DS3231MZ+) is 6.2mm away. Recommended: <3mm for best high-frequency performance.
findings.recommendation: Move decoupling cap closer to U1 power pins if layout permits.
findings.summary: Decoupling cap moderately far from U1

findings.title: No EMC filtering near DS1
findings.description: Connector DS1 (3.5in CAP TOUCH LCD) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near DS1. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near DS1

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on DS1
findings.description: DS1 (3.5in CAP TOUCH LCD) has 1 ground pin(s) for 14 signal pins. Recommended: at least 4 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure DS1 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.
findings.summary: Insufficient ground pins on DS1

findings.title: Long clock trace: /I2S_LRCLK
findings.description: Clock net /I2S_LRCLK is 113mm long. Long clock traces act as antennas and radiate harmonics more effectively.
findings.recommendation: Minimize clock trace length. Place clock source close to destination.
findings.summary: Long clock trace: /I2S_LRCLK

findings.title: Long clock trace: /I2S_BCLK
findings.description: Clock net /I2S_BCLK is 110mm long. Long clock traces act as antennas and radiate harmonics more effectively.
findings.recommendation: Minimize clock trace length. Place clock source close to destination.
findings.summary: Long clock trace: /I2S_BCLK

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (135×95mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 529 MHz; (0,1) at 752 MHz; (1,1) at 920 MHz; (2,0) at 1059 MHz; (2,1) at 1299 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies

findings.title: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /RTC_INT_N
findings.description: Net /RTC_INT_N has 5 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, F.Cu. 1 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 1.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /RTC_INT_N

findings.title: Close trace spacing: /RTC_INT_N / /TP_INT
findings.description: Nets /RTC_INT_N and /TP_INT run parallel for ~14mm on F.Cu within 0.5mm spacing (3H rule requires ≥0.6mm for <3% crosstalk, H=0.20mm).
findings.recommendation: Increase spacing to ≥0.6mm (3× dielectric height) or insert a ground guard trace between them.
findings.summary: Close trace spacing: /RTC_INT_N / /TP_INT

findings.recommendation: Increase spacing to ≥0.6mm (3× dielectric height) or insert a ground guard trace between them.
